summary.en:
- Jing Yuan's main source of damage is his Follow-Up ATK through his summon Lightning-Lord. You will not see a lot of damage from his own Skill or Ultimate.
- Lightning-Lord can have a total of 10 stacks. Jing Yuan's Skill provides 2 and his Ultimate and Technique provide 3.
- Jing Yuan works well with supports who provide advance actions, grant SPD, or grant Energy, helping him deal more DMG and gain Lightning-Lord stacks.
- Note that Lightning-Lord cannot take action when Jing Yuan is Crowd Controlled or downed.
- Jing Yuan's performance is heavily reliant on his teammates, particularly Sunday. Sunday is the most important part of Jing Yuan's team, as he solves the Lightning-Lord's low SPD. Sunday E1 allows Jing Yuan to ignore 16% DEF and Lightning-Lord to ignore 40% DEF. [[character:dhpt]] is a powerful sustain, who provides a strong ATK% buff, and additionally a secondary summon to deal more damage and synergizes well with Sunday.

details.en:
- S1 [[light-cone:before-dawn]] boosts his [[stat:cd]], as well as increasing the DMG dealt by his Skill, Ultimate, and Follow-Up ATK.
- E1 increases Lightning-Lord's DMG to enemies adjacent to the primary enemy target. This is overall an underwhelming increase.
